full_judgment: 2. Facts, leading to filing of this appeal, in short, are that the respondent Nos.1-4 herein as plaintiffs impleading the present appellant as defendants filed aforementioned Title Suit before the learned Assistant Judge for partition of suit property stating inter-alia that the said land appertaining to C.S Khatian No.266 of mouza Shital Danga, P.S. Shailakupa, District-Jhinaidah belonged to Makhon Nessa and others who inherited one third share of C. S. Khatian and possessed the land through her husband, who died leaving behind 2 sons Bahadur and Khorshed, 2 daughters, Fasiron and Passiran and husband Ebratullah, Bahadur died leaving son Japed Ali, wife Paria Nessa and father Ebratullah and Pachiron died leaving behind Saber Hossain and Tarip. Ebratullah died leaving behind one son Khorshed, one daughter Fakiron and he died before promulgation of the Family Law Ordinance, 1961 as a result Japed Ali, Barker Hossain and Tarip did not get any share of late Ebratullah, Paiara Nessa died leaving only son Jabed Ali, who died leaving son Bader Uddin and daughter Rezia and wife Aklima. Khatun, Khorshed died leaving one son Juad Ali and wife Tasiron Nessa and in such a way Juad Ali got 4 annas, 2 kora and 2 kranti and Tasiron Nessa got 6 gonda, 1 kora, 1 kranti. Juad Ali, Tasiron, Fakiron, Rezia transferred 18 acres of land in favour of the plaintiffs on 12.07.1975 from the northern side of the plot No. 1637 and plaintiffs mutated their names and paid rent to the Government and the defendants are the co-sharer of the suit joma and when defendant denied the amicable partition they filed the suit.
